description: This is a React component source file that implements an event form with multi-step validation, using hooks, external UI components, framer-motion animations, and API calls for creating or updating events.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Updates form data state and clears validation errors for a specific field.

methods.name: validateStep
methods.description: Validates the current step's fields and sets validation errors.

methods.name: nextStep
methods.description: Advances to the next step if current step validation passes.

methods.name: prevStep
methods.description: Goes back to the previous step.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission, validates all steps, makes API call to create or update the event, and handles errors.
